354:t_002:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So they were lying in wait for us here?!」

354:t_002:9.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Damn...! Did we walk right into the enemy's trap...?!」

354:t_002:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...I'm surprised, $c. I planned to ambush you as you came back from Mars, and here you show up instead.」

354:t_002:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But since you went to the trouble of coming, all the better! Right before Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$, I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, will crush you all!」

354:t_002:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems they didn't know we were coming.」

354:t_002:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this was only a relay base, and $$ストラウス$$ meant to strike us at another location.」

354:t_002:15.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That woman, $$クィーン$$... So she really was on our side after all...」

354:t_002:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「I can't say for certain yet, but at least regarding the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ matter, it seems she was purely providing information.」

354:t_002:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「What will you do, Miss $$スメラギ$$?」

354:t_002:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「With the other Reactors absent, now is our chance. We'll take down the Empire's Supreme Commander, $$ストラウス$$, and retake the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

354:t_002:19.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The enemy is a fleet. To throw their chain of command into disorder, aggressively target the enemy ships.」

354:t_002:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If we charge in recklessly like this, we'll be ganged up on by enemy units making precise attacks under the battleships' command...!」

354:t_002:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, $$ストラウス$$! I'll be your opponent!」

354:t_003:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's no point in dragging this out...! Let's do it, $n!」

354:t_003:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「...$n. It's only natural that you can't get your head around the whole $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ thing. But forget it for now.」

354:t_003:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive... That's all that matters for now.」

354:t_003:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「It doesn't matter what he's thinking or who he is, does it?」

354:t_003:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've made up your mind, let's go!」

354:t_003:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ストラウス$$! Looks like you know this is the decisive moment too!」

354:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine, $$ストラウス$$! If you weren't my enemy, we might've shared a good drink together!」

354:t_004:2.en:
$$桂$$
「That $$ランド$$! He's going one-on-one with $$ストラウス$$?!」

354:t_004:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's $$ザ・ヒート$$ for you! He's on fire!」

354:t_004:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「W-wait, is this really okay?! Will he be all right?!」

354:t_004:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't spoil a fight between men! All we do is watch it through!」

354:t_004:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But her power as a Reactor is greater than $$ランド$$'s! Even with $n there...!」

354:t_004:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...$$ランド$$ and $$ストラウス$$... This sensation... I remember it...」

354:t_004:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is... the same as back then... the same as at $$インサラウム$$...」

354:t_004:13.en:
$n
「($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... I'm throwing away both my doubts and my expectations...)」

354:t_004:14.en:
$n
「(I'll accept that you're alive, exactly as it is...!)」

354:t_004:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a showdown, $$ストラウス$$!」

354:t_005:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Rapid warping of the dimensional boundary line confirmed!」

354:t_005:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「A $$時空震動|lc$$ at a time like this?!」

354:t_005:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's a 《$$スフィアの共鳴$$》!」

354:t_005:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is that what happened when you rescued $$エスター$$ at $$インサラウム$$?!」

354:t_005:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is an even stronger force than when it was me and $$ユーサー$$!」

354:t_005:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the hell is this...?! I can see something!」

354:t_007:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood, Supreme Commander! We'll destroy that artificial human!」

354:t_009:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So the $$サイデリアル$$ are after $$シンジ$$ and the others!」

354:t_009:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「But there are EVAs of a type I've never seen too!」

354:t_009:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Unit-01 and Unit-02 differ in the details too, but...」

354:t_009:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Nonetheless, since the pilot knows $n, I accept that it's the $$碇シンジ$$ we know! All units, support the four EVAs!」

354:t_009:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Why are we out in space when we were fighting at the very bottom of $$セントラルドグマ$$?!」

354:t_009:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「I knew it. Even if it was only one, getting that spear pulled out was the mistake, it seems.」

354:t_009:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「In short, since we could have destroyed the world, we got expelled from it... I'd say this is the same as at the $$サードインパクト$$.」

354:t_009:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「So what do we do, $$姫$$? Those guys over there look like the $$サイデリアル$$, though...」

354:t_009:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「Looks like not much time has passed in this world since we got warped out of it.」

354:t_009:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Still, to be transported to a place with faces we know...」

354:t_009:11.en:
$$マリ$$
「Lucky, huh? ...Lucky enough that I have to wonder about writing it off as coincidence.」

354:t_009:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Can you hear me, $c? This is $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$.」

354:t_009:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$アスカ$$...! It's you, $$アスカ$$!」

354:t_009:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「You've recovered! That's great...! It's really great!」

kept_omissions: 354:t_009:5: 引き抜かせた - who made whom pull out the spear is left unstated (passive 'getting that spear pulled out').
uncertain: 354:t_002:12 first clause: 'since you went to the trouble of coming, all the better' for わざわざ来たのなら好都合.
354:t_004:8: 'her power as a Reactor is greater than Rand's' - 相手 read as Straus (female, glossary); 'Even with $n there' - $n君 has no honorific in English.
354:t_004:13/14: Hibiki's thoughts addressed to Advent (あなた) - inferred from t_003:4-5.
354:t_005:4: subject of 助け出した supplied as 'you' (Crowe, whose reply t_005:5 says 'me and Uther'), since Alto addresses Crowe.
354:t_009:5: 一本 rendered 'only one' (of the spears); ガキシンジ = 'Brat Shinji'; 姫 = 'Princess' (Mari to Asuka).
354:t_007:3: 人造人間 rendered 'artificial human' (Dabalan's word for the Evangelion, not tokenised).
